name: Curex Alchohol Prep Pads 100pcs Box
description:
Curex Alcohol Prep Pads 100pcs Box | Made in China

Ensure safe and hygienic cleaning with Curex Alcohol Prep Pads. Each pad contains 70% Isopropyl Alcohol, making it ideal for disinfecting skin before injections, minor procedures, or other external uses. Perfect for professional, hospital, or home use.

Key Features:

Brand: Curex

Pack Size: 100 pads per box

Alcohol Content: 70% Isopropyl Alcohol for effective cleaning

Usage: For external use only, suitable for professional and hospital settings

Made in China

Keep your skin clean and protected with Curex Alcohol Prep Pads – convenient, effective, and reliable.
